subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw approve the updated pinned revisions of `openai/codex-action` and `actions/create-github-app-token` where their workflows pass repository secrets?
rationale: Whether to execute upgraded third-party action code with OpenClaw credentials is a repository security-boundary decision that automated review cannot safely make.

options.title: Approve reviewed credential-bearing revisions
options.body: Review and explicitly approve the exact action SHAs, then refresh the branch and validate the affected workflows on its final head.

options.title: Defer sensitive action updates
options.body: Split out or defer the Codex and GitHub App-token action upgrades until a dedicated security review is available.

recommendation.title: Approve reviewed credential-bearing revisions
recommendation.body: Review and explicitly approve the exact action SHAs, then refresh the branch and validate the affected workflows on its final head.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns repository-owned credential-bearing CI workflow policy.
